cohort: The study included 50 obstetric patients diagnosed with obstetric cholestasis, selected from a total of 3201 obstetric patients.
finding: Obstetric cholestasis was associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, and a higher mean alanine aminotransferase (ALT) level was found among those with adverse outcomes, with a cut-off value of 93.5.
mod_finding: The majority of deliveries (70%) in the study cohort were by caesarean section.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 37.54 ± 1.96 weeks, with 58% diagnosed between 34-35 weeks.
